text.en:
The name of the San Isidro Community School in Barangay San Isidro, Municipality of San
Nicolas, Province of Pangasinan, is hereby changed to Bensican-San Isidro Community School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 27, 1984
